newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Omax drills for lead, zinc in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Omax drills for lead, zinc in Indonesia.

text.p: Australian mineral exploration company Omax Resources Ltd will start a new drilling programme next Tuesday to determine whether a deposit of lead and zinc in South Sumatra was commercially viable, its non-executive chairman Louis Clinton said on Wednesday.
Indonesia currently imports all its lead and zinc requirements.

Clinton told Reuters that Omax, with offices in Vancouver and Perth, Australia, had identified a deposit of lead, zinc, gold and silver near Pekanbaru in South Sumatra and work was under way to determine whether there was an ore body.
"They are beginning a new drilling programme on October 15. I would think in four months time they should have a pretty good handle on what they have," he said.
"It would be the first lead-zinc producer in Indonesia if it were to develop," he added.
Clinton said Omax was also exploring for gold in western Java and on Halmahera island in eastern Indonesia.
